eventName: Fifth Annual One Lakh Palm Seeds Planting Festival-12th phase of the field
eventDescription:
As part of the 12th phase of the field initiative, palm seeds were planted around the 7-acre land belonging to the Thiruporur Murugan Temple, with the aim of reviving our green heritage.
Carrying out nature-protective activities on unused and neglected temple lands is a noble effort that helps restore hidden and forgotten resources.
